text_rules: Keep cover text to 3-5 punchy words mixing Hindi/English, always include a specific number (₹ amount, GSM, piece count, or loss figure) paired with a consequence or question mark to create curiosity-gap. Yellow (#FFD400) keywords + white secondary text on dark/product backgrounds massively outperform soft cream/navy or illustration-based covers — never use muted pastel palettes.
layout: Center all text in the 25%-70% vertical band (safe zone) using large bold sans-serif type; product or warehouse imagery fills the background with slight dark overlay so text pops — no faces needed, let the product-hero or damaged-goods visual anchor the bottom third. Keep text stacked in 2-3 short lines, biggest word/number gets the yellow highlight color.
patterns: Top-performing Indian business Reels thumbnails follow a 'money-at-risk' or 'scam-exposed' pattern: a specific rupee loss figure or GSM/quantity mismatch creates instant stakes (e.g., ₹40K Loss, 500 Pcs Crack, 220 GSM लिखा 160 निकली). Bold yellow-on-dark text with a question mark or angry emoji outperforms clean/educational designs by 100x+ in this niche. The worst performers use soft illustration styles, cream backgrounds, and purely Hindi educational questions with no financial stakes or concrete numbers.
ig_patterns: Highest save-rate Reels (1.7%+) use covers promising diagnostic checklists tied to a financial loss scenario — viewers bookmark them as future reference when ordering bulk (e.g., '200 GSM Feels Cheap? 3 Checks'). Highest share-rate covers (1.7-2.5%) expose a common supplier scam or monsoon/seasonal failure that triggers 'my retailer friend needs this warning' — the combination of a specific ₹ loss + a surprising technical cause (humidity, yarn swap, moisture) drives forwarding. Yellow keyword + white text on real product/warehouse backgrounds with zero faces consistently outperform illustration or cream-palette covers in both saves and shares by 50-700x.
